title: Onslaught
subtitle: Alliance-locked Onslaught teams that push your Ascend goals forward, plus the character or Machine of War to pick for the post-battle shard reward.

recipient.title: Post-battle shard recipient
recipient.none: No shard target is configured for this track. Add an Ascend goal that farms Onslaught shards to get a recommendation here.

reason.onlyCandidate: The only unit with an active Onslaught Ascend goal on this track.
reason.inSelectedProject: Its Ascend goal is in your selected project.
reason.overallGoalPriority: Highest-priority Onslaught Ascend goal in your goal list.
reason.fewestRemainingShards: Closest to its target rarity of your Onslaught Ascend goals.

purpose.title: Onslaught team recommendations
purpose.content: Suggested Onslaught teams for one alliance track at a time, and the unit to pick for the post-battle shard reward, so your daily battles advance your Ascend goals.

track.title: Alliance track
track.content: Pick the Imperial, Chaos, or Xenos track. Every recommendation below — teams and shard recipient — is limited to that alliance. Your choice is remembered.

mode.title: XP or Power
mode.content: XP Mode prefers characters that can still earn XP. Power Mode ignores XP and picks your strongest team. Your choice is remembered per page.

project.title: Driving project
project.content: Pick which project the Plan team and the shard recipient are tuned to. This is the same project selection used on the other Dailies tabs.

teamSize.title: Team size
teamSize.content: Choose 3, 4, or 5 characters for both teams. A full team of 5 is the default; drop to 3 or 4 to concentrate each battle's shared XP. Your choice is remembered.

preferences.title: Preferred trait and damage type
preferences.content: Bias both teams toward a trait or damage type you want to field. It is a soft nudge — the team widens within the track's alliance to stay full rather than shrink.

plan.title: Plan team
plan.content: One team led by characters you are ascending with Onslaught shard farming, then your selected project, then your other goals and the track's roster. A note shows when it was widened.

shardRecipient.title: Post-battle shard recipient
shardRecipient.content: After the battle you pick one unit for the shard reward. This panel recommends the best character or Machine of War from your active Onslaught Ascend goals — it does not have to be on the battle team.

locks.title: Lock what you like
locks.content: Lock a character in the Random team and it stays put when you regenerate. Locks reset when you reload or switch track.

regenerate.title: Regenerate
regenerate.content: Shuffle a new Random team. Only the unlocked slots change; it is disabled once every slot is locked.
